headline: Roujay flying mount
title: Roujay | Flying Mount That Gathers And Hauls | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a flying mount that also works in Palworld one point zero? Roujay is a Dark Pal that you can ride as a flying mount. At your base it works Gathering level five and Transporting level five. Its partner skill, Dark-Nester, boosts damage against enemies afflicted with Blind. You find it deep in the World Tree. Will you take to the skies with Roujay? Comment below!
description: Roujay in Palworld 1.0 is a Dark flying mount from the World Tree with Gathering level five and Transporting level five.
joke: Roujay is the only courier that brings its own airline.
